CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   D. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   B. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)

   D. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

5. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Mount Carmel Contest.
   D. Say Mount Carmel Contest has no place in daily life.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

10. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
